title: Trump Claims Hormuz Mines Cleared as Rubio Signals Shift From Strikes to Sanctions
detail: President Trump said via Truth Social on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 that the US Navy had removed or detonated all mines from the international shipping lanes of the Strait of Hormuz, warning Iran that 'any ship or boat placing new mines will be immediately and systematically destroyed' under a 'zero tolerance' policy. A US official confirmed CENTCOM had cleared both inbound and outbound lanes after months of underwater drone detection and contractor removal work, allowing over 500 ships to transit in recent weeks. Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio told foreign counterparts the US is not expected to launch new strikes on Iran 'for the time being,' shifting emphasis to economic pressure — including Treasury Secretary Bessent's sanctions campaign — while not ruling out retaliatory strikes if Iran attacks first.

media.caption: Trump says the US Navy has cleared all mines from the Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes

title: Trump Declares National Emergency to Secure US Power Grid From Foreign Equipment
detail: President Trump signed an executive order on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, declaring a national emergency under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act and National Emergencies Act over what the White House called an 'unusual and extraordinary foreign threat' to America's bulk-power system. The order lets federal agencies block or condition the purchase, importation, transfer, or installation of foreign-produced grid equipment — transformers, generators, battery storage, grid-connected inverters, turbines, and industrial control systems and software — found to pose cybersecurity or sabotage risks, including potential backdoors enabling remote access to critical infrastructure. The Energy Department was directed to issue implementing rules identifying at-risk equipment before the end of 2026; the order excludes local electricity distribution facilities, focusing solely on the bulk-power system.

media.caption: Trump declares a national emergency to secure the US bulk-power system from foreign equipment threats
